title: Report overview and downloads
responsibility: Summarizes the report’s recorded outcome, evidence gaps, lifecycle and available exports.

inputs.name: ReportSummary.report
inputs.description: Required report supplying status, summary, findings, coverage, checks, revision, timestamps and export availability. The gap count includes failed, blocked or not-proven findings and coverage plus a missing revision; it does not count failed checks.

inputs.name: ReportSummary.downloadBase
inputs.description: Required address prefix used to build available PDF, ZIP and HTML download links.

inputs.name: ReportSummary.portable
inputs.description: Optional portable-view flag, defaulting to false. Hides ZIP and HTML downloads while retaining an available PDF link.

outputs.name: ReportSummary
outputs.description: Outcome and summary, passed-check and evidence-gap counts, lifecycle and historical/stale notices, and expandable run metadata. Missing revisions remain not proven. Exports are shown only when available, otherwise as pending; finalizing receives its own notice.
